req.title: Login form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a login form at GET /auth/login.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /auth/login must return an HTTP 2xx response with a login form. I design: (1) a positive EP test verifying exact status 200 and presence of key HTML form elements (username/password inputs and form action); (2) a negative NEG test verifying that a non-existent sub-path returns exactly 404, not 200; (3) a BVA boundary test verifying the exact status code is 200 (not 199, not 201) and that the Content-Type header contains 'text/html', catching constant-mutation and comparison-flip mutations. Additional tests cover state (unauthenticated vs authenticated session) and method boundary (POST vs GET on the same endpoint).

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_get_returns_200_with_form_fields():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/login')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'name="username"' in r.data
    assert b'name="password"' in r.data
    assert b'/auth/login' in r.data

test_login_get_returns_200_with_form_fields()

    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():

tests.name: test_login_get_authenticated_user_still_serves_form
preconditions: Flask app created with TESTING=True and a temporary database
A session with user_id=1 is active (authenticated state)
actions: Set session user_id=1 to simulate logged-in state
Send GET /auth/login via Flask test client
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 200 (login page is accessible even when authenticated)
trace: R-FLASKR-007: login view has no login_required guard; must serve form regardless of session state

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_get_authenticated_user_still_serves_form():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        sess['user_id'] = 1
    r = client.get('/auth/login')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'name="username"' in r.data

tests.name: test_login_post_not_get_returns_non_redirect_on_empty
preconditions: Flask app created with TESTING=True and a temporary database
actions: Send POST /auth/login with empty username and password
Verify the response is NOT a 2xx redirect to index (i.e., login failed)
Then send GET /auth/login and verify status 200
expected: POST with empty credentials returns 200 (re-renders form with error, not redirect)
trace: R-FLASKR-007: distinguishes GET (form render) from POST (form submit); GET must always be 200
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_post_not_get_returns_non_redirect_on_empty():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r_post = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': '', 'password': ''})
    assert r_post.status_code == 200
    assert r_post.status_code != 302
    r_get = client.get('/auth/login')
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    assert b'name="username"' in r_get.data
    assert b'name="password"' in r_get.data

test_login_post_not_get_returns_non_redirect_on_empty()

Check response data length is greater than 0
Check response data contains opening HTML tag

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_get_response_body_not_empty_and_contains_html():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/login')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert len(r.data) > 0
    lower_data = r.data.lower()
    assert b'<!doctype' in lower_data or b'<html' in lower_data
    assert b'<form' in lower_data
